name: figure-making-wxl
title_zh: 投稿前把图改成期刊要的那副样子
tagline_zh: 论文被审稿人挑「图不规范」最耗人：它按 Elsevier / IEEE / Springer 的版式把字号、配色。
tagline_en: Reviewers flagging non-compliant figures costs days. It restyles fonts, palette, boxed axes, inward ticks.
desc_en: Publication-ready matplotlib figures in the WXL house style for Elsevier, IEEE and Springer submissions: every text element is Times New Roman at 11 pt (legend at 10 pt), with a soft science semantic palette, full-box axes, framed in-plot legends, inward ticks, no grid, captions below the figure, and figure widths fixed to the final print width (90 / 140 / 190 mm). why_zh: 不是套模板，是把「印刷宽度决定字号」这条硬约束写进流程：先定栏宽再排版。
why_en: It encodes the hard rule that print width drives font size: pick the column width first, then 11pt Times text and 10pt legends.
limit_zh: 只服务 matplotlib 出图，Origin、Illustrator、PPT 画的图它管不了。
limit_en: Matplotlib only — Origin, Illustrator or PPT figures are out of scope. Covers Elsevier/IEEE/Springer styles only. It restyles, it does not catch.
title_en: Matplotlib figures restyled to journal house rules
